title: C++ Storage Classes
description: Storage-class specifiers and storage duration in C++: the old and new meaning of auto, the removal of register, static and extern, thread_local, mutable, linkage, static class members and extern "C".

descriptionI18n.zh-Hant: C++ 的儲存類別修飾符與儲存期：auto 的舊義與新義、register 的移除、static 與 extern、thread_local、mutable、連結性、靜態類別成員，以及 extern "C"。

questions.prompt: What did the `auto` keyword mean before C++11, and what does it mean now?

prompt.zh-Hant: C++11 之前 `auto` 的意義是甚麼？現在又是甚麼？

a.zh-Hant: 以前是表示自動儲存期的儲存類別修飾符；C++11 起改為從初始值推導型別。

b.zh-Hant: 一直都代表從初始值推導變數型別。

d.zh-Hant: C++11 才新增，之前沒有任何意義。

explanation.zh-Hant: C++98 的 `auto` 用來標示自動儲存期，幾乎總是多餘的。C++11 重新使用這個關鍵字來做型別推導，舊的意義已被移除。

options.text: It was a storage-class specifier for automatic storage duration; since C++11 it deduces the type from the initialiser.
It has always deduced the variable's type from its initialiser.
It used to mean `register`, and now it means `static`.
It was introduced in C++11 and had no earlier meaning.

questions.explanation: In C++98 `auto` marked automatic storage duration and was almost always redundant. C++11 reused the keyword for type deduction, and the old meaning was removed.

questions.prompt: What is the status of the `register` storage-class specifier in C++17?

prompt.zh-Hant: `register` 儲存類別修飾符在 C++17 的狀態是甚麼？

a.zh-Hant: 已被移除；`register` 是保留字，`register int x;` 不符語法。

b.zh-Hant: 仍然要求編譯器把變數放進 CPU 暫存器。

c.zh-Hant: 現在會給變數執行緒儲存期。

d.zh-Hant: 迴圈中使用的變數必須加它。

explanation.zh-Hant: `register` 在 C++11 被標為棄用，C++17 正式移除，因為編譯器配置暫存器的能力遠勝人為提示。C++17 之後這個關鍵字仍保留，但已沒有意義。

options.text: It was removed; `register` is a reserved word and `register int x;` is ill-formed.
It still asks the compiler to place the variable in a CPU register.
It now gives the variable thread storage duration.
It is required for variables used inside loops.

questions.explanation: `register` was deprecated in C++11 and removed in C++17, because compilers allocate registers far better than programmers can hint. In C++17 the keyword remains reserved but has no meaning.

questions.prompt: Which declaration gives a namespace-scope function internal linkage?

prompt.zh-Hant: 下列哪一個宣告會讓命名空間範圍的函式具有內部連結？

explanation.zh-Hant: 在命名空間範圍加上 `static` 會給函式（或變數）內部連結，每個編譯單元各自擁有自己的版本。`extern` 與不加修飾的宣告是外部連結；`inline` 影響的是單一定義規則（ODR），不是連結性。

options.text: `static void helper();`
`extern void helper();`
`void helper();`
`inline void helper();`

questions.explanation: `static` at namespace scope gives a function (or variable) internal linkage, so each translation unit gets its own copy. `extern` and a plain declaration give external linkage; `inline` affects the ODR, not linkage.

questions.prompt: Which statement about a `static` data member of a class is correct?

prompt.zh-Hant: 關於類別的 `static` 資料成員，下列敘述何者正確？

a.zh-Hant: 所有物件共用同一份，且需要在類別外定義（C++17 起可用 `inline` 在類別內定義）。

b.zh-Hant: 每個物件各自儲存一份。

c.zh-Hant: 它具有執行緒儲存期，每個執行緒一份。

d.zh-Hant: 它不能是 `const`，也不能在類別本體內初始化。

explanation.zh-Hant: 靜態資料成員屬於類別而非物件，所有物件看到同一份儲存空間。C++17 之前必須在類別外定義，C++17 起可以用 `inline static` 直接在類別內定義。

options.text: There is one instance shared by all objects, and it needs a definition outside the class (or an `inline` definition since C++17).
Each object stores its own copy of the member.
It has thread storage duration and one copy per thread.
It cannot be `const` or initialised in the class body.

questions.explanation: A static data member belongs to the class, not to an object, so all objects see the same storage. Before C++17 it needed an out-of-class definition; C++17 allows `inline static` members defined in the class.

questions.prompt: Which of these are storage durations defined by the C++ standard? Select all that apply.

prompt.zh-Hant: 下列哪些是 C++ 標準定義的儲存期？可多選。

explanation.zh-Hant: 標準的四種儲存期是自動、靜態、執行緒與動態（dynamic）。`register` 不是儲存期，它曾是儲存類別修飾符，已在 C++17 移除。

options.text: automatic
static
thread
register

questions.explanation: The four standard storage durations are automatic, static, thread and dynamic. `register` is not a storage duration; it used to be a storage-class specifier and was removed in C++17.

questions.prompt: Which statements about `static` are true? Select all that apply.

prompt.zh-Hant: 關於 `static`，下列敘述何者正確？可多選。

a.zh-Hant: 檔案範圍的 `static` 變數具有內部連結，其他編譯單元看不到。

b.zh-Hant: 函式內的 `static` 變數會保留數值，且只初始化一次。

c.zh-Hant: `static` 成員函式沒有 `this` 指標，可以不經物件直接呼叫。

d.zh-Hant: 函式內的 `static` 變數會在函式返回時銷毀。

explanation.zh-Hant: 在命名空間範圍，`static` 表示內部連結；在函式內，它表示只有一份且存活到程式結束的實例。靜態成員函式屬於類別而非物件，因此沒有 `this`。

options.text: A file-scope `static` variable has internal linkage and is not visible to other translation units.
A function-local `static` keeps its value between calls and is initialised only once.
A `static` member function has no `this` pointer and can be called without an object.
A function-local `static` is destroyed when its function returns.

questions.explanation: `static` means internal linkage at namespace scope, and one persistent instance for a local. Static member functions belong to the class, not to an object, so they have no `this`. A local static lives until program exit.

questions.prompt: A `thread_local` variable is initialised once per thread and destroyed when that thread exits.

prompt.zh-Hant: `thread_local` 變數在每個執行緒各初始化一次，並在該執行緒結束時銷毀。

explanation.zh-Hant: `thread_local` 讓物件具有執行緒儲存期：每個使用它的執行緒各有自己的實例，由該執行緒首次使用時初始化，並在執行緒結束時銷毀。

questions.explanation: `thread_local` gives an object thread storage duration: each thread that uses it gets its own instance, initialised on first use by that thread and destroyed when the thread ends.

questions.prompt: The `mutable` specifier can be applied to a local variable so that it stays modifiable inside a `const` member function.

prompt.zh-Hant: `mutable` 修飾符可以套用在區域變數上，讓它在 `const` 成員函式中仍可修改。

explanation.zh-Hant: `mutable` 只能套用在非靜態資料成員（以及 lambda 擷取）。區域變數與 const 成員函式無關，這樣宣告不符語法。

questions.explanation: `mutable` applies only to non-static data members (and lambda captures). A local variable has no `const` member function to be exempted from, so that declaration is ill-formed.

questions.prompt: Since C++11, the keyword ____ asks the compiler to deduce a variable's type from its initialiser.

prompt.zh-Hant: 自 C++11 起，關鍵字 ____ 會請編譯器從初始值推導變數的型別。

explanation.zh-Hant: `auto x = 1.5;` 會讓 `x` 成為 `double`。變數仍有固定的靜態型別，推導只在編譯期發生一次。

questions.explanation: `auto x = 1.5;` makes `x` a `double`. The variable still has a fixed static type; deduction happens once, at compile time.

questions.prompt: Explain what `extern "C"` does and why it is needed when C++ calls a C library.

prompt.zh-Hant: 說明 `extern "C"` 的作用，以及 C++ 呼叫 C 程式庫時為何需要它。

model.zh-Hant: `extern "C"` 讓函式或變數具有 C 語言連結。C++ 通常會對名稱做修飾（name mangling），把參數型別編進符號名稱以支援多載；C 編譯器則輸出未修飾的名稱。加上 C 語言連結後，C++ 編譯器會採用 C 的符號名稱，連結器才找得到 C 程式庫中的函式。它不改變 C++ 型別或執行期行為，但會讓區塊內的函式失去多載。

explanation.zh-Hant: 關鍵在符號名稱：C++ 的名稱修飾與 C 不同，`extern "C"` 讓兩邊的符號對得上。

answer.model: `extern "C"` gives a function or variable C language linkage. C++ normally mangles names to encode parameter types so overloading works, while C compilers emit the plain name; C language linkage makes the C++ compiler use the C symbol name, so the linker can find the C library's function. It does not change the C++ types or the runtime behaviour, and it disables overloading within the block.

questions.explanation: The point is the symbol name: C++ mangles names and C does not, and `extern "C"` makes both sides agree.
